description: Verify the NPORT cross-filer annualized coupon rate (annualized_rate) for one security identifier. Security-grain, N-source receipt: citations are peer NPORT-P filings by registrant CIK, dissenters included. CURRENT-ONLY (latest NPORT period exported). Ticker matches are not unique: set require_hard_identifier=true when a claim needs ISIN, CUSIP or other hard identity.

as_of.description: Optional NPORT period guard (YYYY-MM). The public corpus is latest-period-per-security, not historical.

claimed_value.description: Claim to receipt. Required: no claim = refusal, no value.

identifier.description: Security identifier to look up: ISIN, CUSIP, other identifier, or ticker.

require_hard_identifier.description: When true, exclude ticker-sourced matches because tickers are not unique hard identifiers.

security_id_source.description: Optional source filter. Default any. Use ticker only for ticker-sourced matches.

name: verify_fund_holding_coupon

resolved_security.description: Security resolution: matched, security_id, hard_identifier, candidates.

title: Verify NPORT cross-filer fund-holding coupon
